result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but the promotional banner has a serious readability issue and the fixed bottom navigation visually overlaps the restaurant feed.

issues.description: The white headline and offer details in the pale mint promotional banner have very low contrast and are difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use substantially darker text or a darker banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second restaurant card, making the content appear cut off behind it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable feed equal to the navigation height plus the safe-area inset so cards can scroll fully above the bar.

issues.description: The category row ends with a mostly blank, partially visible pill at the right edge, which can look like a clipped or broken control.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal spacing or scroll position so enough of the next category label is visible to clearly indicate that the row is horizontally scrollable.
